item.title: Russia Halts Some Nitrogen Fertiliser Exports, Russia Is Malaysia’s Top Imported Fertiliser Origin
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Russia has suspended ammonium nitrate fertiliser exports until April 21, after China similarly curbed fertiliser exports. Russia and China are Malaysia's two biggest sources of imported fertilisers. KPKM has yet to address Malaysia's fertiliser situation. The post Russia Halts Some Nitrogen Fertiliser Exports, Russia Is Malaysia’s Top Imported Fertiliser Origin appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Delay In SWE Certification, NSR Registration Process — Senior Medical Officer
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
We were informed by MOH's medical development division that the document verification process alone for SWE certification may take 6-8 months. Only then can candidates proceed with NSR registration, which itself may require additional processing time.
